run_language_detection: run whisper language detection on a list of wav files and output n-best predictions
detect_language_with_whisper: detect language from audio files using whisper model and save top N language probabilities
load_and_preprocess_audio: load audio files and pad or trim to 30 seconds for whisper language identification
generate_log_mel_spectrogram: generate log-Mel spectrogram from audio for whisper model language detection input
map_language_codes: map whisper language identification codes to MMS language codes using a mapping file
